import trimesh, numpy as np
m=trimesh.load("exports/model.arm_upper.6773311f.stl")
print(m.bounds)
for name,box in [
 ("thumb_tab",[[109,7,1.0],[114,13,2.2]]),
 ("latch_lip",[[98.3,7,5.8],[99.9,13,6.1]]),
 ("latch_tower",[[101,7,4.0],[105,13,5.5]]),
]:
    lo=np.array(box[0]); hi=np.array(box[1])
    xs=np.linspace(lo[0],hi[0],10); ys=np.linspace(lo[1],hi[1],8); zs=np.linspace(lo[2],hi[2],5)
    pts=np.array(np.meshgrid(xs,ys,zs)).reshape(3,-1).T
    inside=m.contains(pts)
    print(name, inside.mean(), "n", len(pts))
